summary: "Eagle Descent: DSKY" is an interactive web-based simulation of the Apollo Guidance Computer interface and lunar module flight. It allows users to execute real AGC verb-noun commands, navigate historical program alarms like the 1201 and 1202 overflows, pilot the Eagle lander, and complete post-landing alignments and ascent. This project addresses the challenge of making the complex, high-stakes operational procedures of the Apollo 11 mission accessible and engaging. By translating historical technical specifications, flight manuals, and computer architecture into an interactive game, it bridges the gap between raw historical data and experiential learning.
